section.p: Consider a Markdown topic containing a simple three-column table describing alarm severity levels.

entry.codeblock: # Alarm Severity Levels | Severity | Priority | Description | |-----------|-----------|-----------| | Critical | High | Immediate action required | | Warning | Medium | Requires investigation | | Informational | Low | Informational event |

<reference id="alarm_severity_levels"> <title>Alarm Severity Levels</title> <refbody> <simpletable> <sthead> <stentry>Severity</stentry> <stentry>Priority</stentry> <stentry>Description</stentry> </sthead> <strow> <stentry>Critical</stentry> <stentry>High</stentry> <stentry>Immediate action required</stentry> </strow> <strow> <stentry>Warning</stentry> <stentry>Medium</stentry> <stentry>Requires investigation</stentry> </strow> <strow> <stentry>Informational</stentry> <stentry>Low</stentry> <stentry>Informational event</stentry> </strow> </simpletable> </refbody> </reference>

section.p: Result: The converter creates a DITA <simpletable> because the table contains a regular row-column structure with no special formatting.
